a layer-by-layer self-assembling technique was used to prepare a complex membrane composed of NaCS and chitosan.
the layer-by-layer complex membrane was prepared by the layer-by-layer assembly technique from sodium cellulose sulphate and chitosan.
the complex membrane composed of NaCS and chitosan was prepared by using layer-by-layer self-assembling method,and the formation of complex film was affected significantly by preparation conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation,characterization,and application of the sodium cellulose sulfate and chitosan complex membrane.
the preparation and characterization of the layer-by-layer complex membrane composed of NaCS and chitosan,and the research results would be useful in the development of new membrane materials.
the preparation of complex membrane composed of NaCS and chitosan, and the mechanism of the formation of complex membranes was studied.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the complex membrane was successfully prepared by the layer-by-layer assembly technique,and the preparation conditions would have a significant influence on the membrane formation process and the complex membrane formation mechanism.

the layer-by-layer assembly complex membrane composed of NaCS and chitosan was formed by electrostatic interaction between the negative charged NaCS and positive charged chitosan, the formation of complex membranes was a one-order process, and the preparation conditions would affect the formation of complex film.
the complex membrane formed by the layer-by-layer method was composed of two kinds of polymers,which could be used as a new kind of membrane with excellent biocompatibilty.

the complex membrane was prepared successfully by using the layer-by- layer self-assembly technique,which would provide a new idea for the preparation of polysaccharide membrane with excellent biocompatible and biodegradable.

the layer-by-layer complex membrane formed by sodium cellulose sulfate and chitosan was a kind of complex membrane with excellent biocompati-bility and the layer-by layer self-assembly complex formation was a one- order reaction process under the conditions used in the current study.

the layer-by-layer assembly of NaCS and chitosan can form complex membranes with excellent biocompatible and biodegradable properties,and the complex membranes have a potential application prospect in the field of tissue engineering.
the formation of NaCS-chitosan complex membrane was a one-order process and it could provide a theoretical basis for the further application of the NaCS-chitosa complex membrane.
